title: Chisco
description: Chisco is a Chinese imagined speech EEG dataset comprising recordings from five participants across multiple sessions. The dataset includes raw EEG data collected over 5-6 sessions per participant, along with preprocessed data in both fif and pkl formats. It is designed to support research in brain-computer interfaces and speech imagery decoding using electroencephalography. Note: The dataset includes data from two cohorts collected under different BIDS protocol versions (sub-01 to sub-03 vs sub-04 to sub-05) to preserve compatibility with published data processing code.
methods_description: EEG data were collected from five participants (sub-01 to sub-05) across 5-6 sessions per participant. Raw data are provided in EDF format, with preprocessed derivatives available in fif and pkl formats. Text stimuli used during data collection are included in the dataset.

funding_references.funder_name: National Natural Science Foundation of China
